name: ^stepAttributes$
reason: Caller-supplied callback of closeOrphans; the twin checks the step number it is asked about and uses its answer as span attributes.

name: ^identity\.publish$
reason: Caller-supplied publisher in the run span identity; the twin checks the exact row it is given and nothing reads its answer.

name: ^inputs\.restoreObservabilityContext$
reason: Caller-supplied callback of the run finalizer; the twin checks when it runs and reads no answer.

name: ^baseFetch$
reason: Caller-supplied fetch of connectionFetch; the twin checks the URL and the headers carrying the bearer token and returns its response.
